title: SearchPortal — Product Search UNION Injection
objective: The product category filter runs directly against a real SQLite database. Use a UNION-based SQL injection to pull data out of a table the search feature was never meant to touch.

verifier.condition: A UNION SELECT appended to the category filter causes a row from the hidden vault table (not the products table) to appear in the search results.

weakness: The category filter is concatenated into a SELECT, so a UNION can pull rows from a table the page never meant to expose.
seededData: SQLite: products table plus a hidden vault table; per-instance file.
solutionHint: The category filter is a plain text box, not a dropdown — the app trusts whatever you type straight into a SQL query. The results table has 4 columns: id, name, price, category. Can you UNION SELECT 4 values from somewhere else?
